stories.title: Two litter fines in a year, so should Flintshire bring back the private wardens?
stories.summary: A Flintshire cabinet member has asked why private contractors cannot be brought back to hand out litter fines, after the council’s own short-staffed team issued two last year. stories.title: Man jailed for three years after driving stolen taxi the wrong way on the A55
stories.summary: A man who stole a taxi in Holyhead, seriously injured a cyclist and then drove the wrong way along the A55 has been jailed for three years. Darragh O’Grady, 31, was sentenced at Caernarfon Crown Court today, Tuesday 10 November. stories.title: Formal objections open on plan to merge Catholic schools in Mold, Flint and Saltney
stories.summary: A 28-day window for formal objections to plans to close four Catholic schools in Flintshire and replace them with a single 3-18 school in Flint opened today.
